title: E-FRC-0092: deterministic reversible SU(3) gauge dynamics from a fixed pattern, with no random number anywhere...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0092 in the gauge arena: deterministic reversible SU(3) gauge dynamics from a fixed pattern, with no random number anywhere, thermalizes to the canonical ensemble at the coupling its own kinetic temperature predicts, while an abelian start never spreads into color.
